name: Errasaga
summary:
This is an RPG game made with RPG Maker VX .

It is the 3rd work of the 'Age of Myth Series', an RPG for all ages produced by the Circle, and with this work as a starting point, the basic framework of the Age of Mythology work was established. It is also the first work in which a character from the previous work appears in the lead role.

The work directly related to this work is SEQUEL kludge. They are set in the same world and are closely related.
